name: sticky-grid-scroll
title: Sticky Grid Scroll
description: A scroll-driven image grid in a sticky section: columns slide in from above and below, the grid zooms open, and a title, description and action settle into the space.
author: Theo Plawinski <https://github.com/theoplawinski>
docs: Installed `StickyGridScroll` in `components/ui/sticky-grid-scroll.tsx` (it uses `motion`). Render it in a full-width page section: `See the work} />`. It is 4.25 screens tall and sticks while you scroll through it. For the original feel, wrap the page in the Labs `smooth-scroll` item (``) with `options={{ lerp: 0.08, wheelMultiplier: 1.4 }}`. Inside a scroll container, pass it as `container` and give it `container-type: size`. Sizes scale with the section's width (1440 px is the design width).
